Secret Service agents swiftly escorted President Trump to safety as attendees took cover. The shooter was apprehended, and Trump praised security efforts.
title: From Ronald Reagan to Trump: How Washington Hilton hotel became scene of panic once again

author: TOI CITY DESK
description: A birthday celebration in Bulandshahr tragically turned violent after a minor cake-smearing prank escalated into a fatal altercation. Three young men were shot and killed by the birthday boy and his accomplices, who allegedly returned with firearms after an initial argument. Investigations are ongoing to apprehend the absconding accused.
title: UP triple murder: 3 shot dead after cake-smearing dispute at birthday party inside gym

author: TIMESOFINDIA.COM
description: Jaipur witnessed a cricketing marvel as 15-year-old Vaibhav Sooryavanshi smashed a 36-ball century, including 12 sixes. Opposing captain Pat Cummins, a seasoned bowler, declared Sooryavanshi his new favourite player, awestruck by his power-hitting.  This performance has captivated the cricket world, with fellow players also acknowledging his exceptional talent and game awareness.
title: When Australia starts watching: How Vaibhav Sooryavanshi became IPL 2026's global breakout star

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: A fan grabbing Abhishek Sharma’s hand during IPL 2026 sparked debate over personal boundaries, with security stepping in as the moment went viral. On the field, he scored 57 alongside Ishan Kishan’s 74 to help Sunrisers Hyderabad chase 229 against Rajasthan Royals. Vaibhav Sooryavanshi’s brilliant 103 went in vain as SRH sealed a record chase.
title: Shocking! Fangirl forcibly pulls Abhishek's hand; security steps in - Watch

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: A gunman, identified as Cole Tomas Allen, attempted to breach security at the White House Correspondents' Dinner, firing at a Secret Service agent who was protected by a bulletproof vest. President Trump described the suspect as a "lone wolf" and stated the attack was not linked to the war in Iran.
title: ‘Lone wolf’: Trump shares visuals of shooter Cole Allen Thomas running past security

author: TOI NEWS DESK
title: 'Relieved to learn Trump, First Lady safe': PM Modi says violence has no place in democracy

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: Chennai Super Kings, buoyed by a massive win, face Gujarat Titans with MS Dhoni's return still a mystery. Despite being match-fit, Dhoni is reportedly delaying his comeback to maintain CSK's winning combination. Head coach Stephen Fleming confirmed his progress, while the team looks to leverage home advantage at Chepauk.
title: IPL: Will MS Dhoni play today against Gujarat Titans in Chepauk?

author: TNN
description: A notorious YouTuber, Salim Wastik, once Salim Khan, has been apprehended by Delhi Police after 26 years on the run. He was convicted for kidnapping and murdering a 13-year-old boy for ransom in 1995. After jumping bail in 2000, he reinvented himself, gaining fame for his controversial online content.
title: How Salim Khan became 'ex-Muslim Salim Wastik'; arrested after 31 years

author: RATNAKAR MANNE
description: The BWF has approved a new 3x15 scoring system in badminton, set to be implemented from January, after strong support at its AGM. While trials showed shorter, more exciting matches, opinions are divided. PV Sindhu urged meaningful change, Satwik welcomed it for doubles, but Saina Nehwal and coach Vimal Kumar opposed it, fearing it could dilute the sport’s essence.
title: Major change in badminton! BWF approves new 3x15 scoring system

author: CHIDANAND RAJGHATTA
description: Shots rang out near the White House Correspondents' Association dinner, prompting the hurried evacuation of President Trump and other dignitaries. The Secret Service apprehended one individual and is investigating the incident, which occurred shortly before Trump was to deliver his keynote speech.
title: Trump evacuated from media dinner after gunshots; supporters say another assassination attempt

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: Punjab Kings pulled off a record chase against Delhi Capitals, but a playful moment stole the show as Preity Zinta jokingly punched Priyansh Arya, whose reaction went viral. Ravi Shastri quipped, “Oh, that was a good punch.” Earlier, KL Rahul’s 152 powered DC to 264/2, but Punjab responded strongly, with Prabhsimran, Arya, and Shreyas Iyer leading a stunning chase to stay unbeaten.
title: Preity Zinta punches Arya, batter’s reaction goes viral – Watch

author: SAURABH SINHA
description: Six passengers were hospitalized after a SWISS flight from Delhi to Zurich was evacuated on the runway due to an engine fire during takeoff. The Airbus A330's engine number one failed at 104 knots, prompting the crew to abort the takeoff and evacuate all 232 passengers and crew using emergency slides.
title: Engine fire on SWISS Delhi-Zurich flight during take off roll; aircraft evacuated on runway

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: Vaibhav Sooryavanshi dazzled with a 37-ball 103, powering Rajasthan Royals to 228/6, earning praise from Pat Cummins, who called him his “new favourite player.” Supported by Dhruv Jurel’s 51, RR set a strong total. However, Sunrisers Hyderabad chased it down, led by Ishan Kishan’s 74 and Abhishek Sharma’s 57, sealing a thrilling win.
title: Watch: Sooryavanshi now has Aussie fan; Cummins's ‘new favourite player’

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: Karun Nair endured a tough night as Delhi Capitals lost to Punjab Kings, who chased a record 265. Nair dropped Shreyas Iyer twice, allowing him to score 71 and seal the win. The moment went viral, with fans resurfacing Nair’s old “Dear cricket” post. Visibly shaken, the 34-year-old’s struggles highlighted both the cost of missed chances and his ongoing journey of resilience.
title: 'Dear cricket, give me one more chance': Karun Nair's old post resurfaces

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Panic erupted at the White House Correspondents' Dinner as gunshots were heard, forcing President Trump and Vice President Vance to be swiftly evacuated. Secret Service agents secured the venue, apprehending a suspect. Despite the scare, Trump praised security and declared "the show must go on." The incident caused widespread confusion and a massive security response.
title: Watch: Donald Trump ducks for cover as security rushes to evacuate him

author: MAITREE BARAL
description: A silent health crisis is unfolding in India as self-medication with over-the-counter painkillers, antibiotics, and supplements leads to acute liver failure. Dr. Kavya Harika Dendukuri highlights that paracetamol, NSAIDs, and unregulated supplements are major culprits, often causing irreversible damage before symptoms appear. This widespread practice, fueled by a lack of awareness, puts millions at risk.
title: India’s self-medication habit: You are not just treating a headache, you could be harming your liver

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: LeBron James and Bronny James made NBA playoff history with the league’s first father-son scoring connection, as LeBron set up an alley-oop finished by Bronny in Game 3 against the Houston Rockets. Beyond the highlight, the moment underscored LeBron’s unmatched longevity, allowing their careers to overlap in a meaningful, competitive playoff setting rather than a symbolic appearance.
title: LeBron, Bronny make NBA history with first father-son playoff alley-oop

author: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
description: Ranveer Singh's 'Dhurandhar 2' continues its strong box office run, nearing Rs 1,130 crore in India and Rs 1,780 crore worldwide after 38 days. Despite competition, the film saw significant growth on its 6th Saturday, earning Rs 2.95 crore domestically.  Meanwhile, 'Bhooth Bangla' and 'Michael' also performed on Saturday.
title: ‘Dhurandhar 2’ mints Rs 2.95 cr amid ‘Michael' and ‘Bhooth Bangla’ buzz

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: President Donald Trump was evacuated from the White House Correspondents' Dinner after shots were fired, with the suspect apprehended by the Secret Service. An individual reportedly attempted to enter with a gun but was stopped before reaching the ballroom. Trump praised law enforcement and urged the event to continue.
title: ‘Taken offsite’: What we know so far about the shooter at Trump’s WH dinner

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: Fifteen-year-old Vaibhav Sooryavanshi has shattered T20 cricket records, becoming the youngest and fastest to 1,000 runs in just 473 balls. His recent 36-ball century, featuring 12 sixes, marks his second IPL hundred under 40 balls, placing him in an elite group. Sooryavanshi also holds the record for the quickest 50 IPL sixes.
title: Youngest. Fastest. Unstoppable! Sooryavanshi scripts history yet again

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: A major security incident disrupted the White House Correspondents' Association dinner, forcing the evacuation of President Trump and other top officials. Witnesses reported hearing five to eight gunshots, and a shooter was confirmed by law enforcement, though details remain unclear. No injuries were immediately reported among the hundreds of guests.
title: Shooter fires 5 to 8 shots at White House dinner, Trump evacuated - what we know so far

author: TOI WORLD DESK
title: Trump evacuated after shots fired during White House Correspondents' Dinner

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: President Trump stated he was asked to leave the White House Correspondents' Dinner venue due to protocol after shots were fired. He confirmed the shooter's apprehension and praised law enforcement's swift and brave response. Trump indicated the dinner would be rescheduled within 30 days.
title: 'Quite an evening': Trump wanted 'the show to go on' after shooting at White House Correspondents' Dinner

author: TNN
description: Uttar Pradesh is reeling under a severe heatwave, with Banda recording a scorching 47.4 degrees Celsius, its highest in April since 1951. Many districts exceeded 42 degrees Celsius, and the heatwave is expected to persist until Monday. Relief might arrive Tuesday with a western disturbance bringing light rainfall.
title: Banda hottest in country at 47.4℃ as UP reels under heatwave

author: IPSITA PATI
description: An unprecedented exodus of domestic workers to West Bengal for elections has created a severe shortage in Gurgaon, straining instant help services. Wait times for bookings have extended to several days, and available workers are facing doubled workloads and longer hours to meet the surge in demand.
title: Voting in Bengal, help-less in Gurgaon: On ‘10-min’ apps, wait time for slots is 3-5 days

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: Rajasthan Royals' Vaibhav Sooryavanshi, aged 15, achieved a record-breaking 103 off 37 balls in IPL 2026, becoming the youngest to 1,000 T20 runs. He later suffered an injury scare, appearing to be battling severe cramps after his explosive innings. Despite his heroics, Sunrisers Hyderabad secured a thrilling five-wicket victory.
title: Vabihav Sooryavanshi injury scare: 15-year-old leaves the field in pain

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: Karun Nair's dropped catches proved costly as Punjab Kings achieved the IPL's highest successful chase, overcoming Delhi Capitals' 265. Shreyas Iyer, granted two lifelines by Nair, capitalized with a match-winning 71. Earlier, Prabhsimran Singh and Priyansh Arya's explosive opening stand set the stage for the record-breaking victory.
title: Karun Nair Left Devastated, On the Verge of Tears as PBKS Script Record Chase

author: MAHESH BUDDI
description: An IndiGo passenger bound for Udaipur was apprehended at Hyderabad airport for allegedly photographing female cabin crew inappropriately and harassing a co-passenger. The businessman, reportedly intoxicated, was deboarded after ignoring warnings. Police have registered a case under the new penal code for insulting a woman's modesty.
title: 'Zoomed camera focusing on legs': Drunk flyer films female crew on Hyderabad–Udaipur flight

author: TNN
description: A former domestic worker was taken to the home of a senior bureaucrat in Delhi to recreate the crime scene where he allegedly raped and killed the officer's daughter. The accused described his actions, including accessing an electronic safe, and his plan to flee to Rajasthan with stolen valuables.
title: IRS officer daughter rape-murder: Accused made to retrace footsteps to find out how he entered
